output_list.reason: The reward function uses the block number (block.number) as a condition to limit the transfer amount, which can be exploited for malicious behaviors.
Reentrancy vulnerability exists when an invocation to call.value can call back to itself through a chain of calls, allowing unexpected repeated money transfers.
Delegatecall vulnerability arises when an attacker can manipulate the argument of delegatecall, potentially gaining control over the contract and executing arbitrary code.
Integer overflow vulnerability occurs when an arithmetic operation results in a numeric value outside the range of the integer type, causing truncated values due to limitations in the EVM stack.
